# Law Dog

> Law Dog is a Los Angeles personal injury law firm representing car accident, truck accident, motorcycle, rideshare, pedestrian, slip and fall, premises liability, catastrophic injury, and wrongful death victims throughout Southern California. Contingency fee — no fee unless we win.

Phone: (833) 4LAWDOG (+1-833-452-9364)
Email: hello@getlawdog.com
Address: 515 Flower St, Los Angeles, CA 90071

## Practice Pages — Los Angeles

- [Car Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/car-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Car accident claims — rear-end, T-bone, hit-and-run, rideshare, DUI crashes.
- [Truck Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/truck-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Commercial truck and 18-wheeler collision claims.
- [Motorcycle Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/motorcycle-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Motorcycle crash claims, lane-splitting and left-turn cases.
- [Rideshare Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/rideshare-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Uber and Lyft accident claims, multi-layer insurance coverage disputes.
- [Pedestrian & Bicycle Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/pedestrian-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Crosswalk strikes, hit-and-run, dooring, bike lane collisions.
- [Catastrophic Injury Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/catastrophic-injury-lawyer-los-angeles): Spinal cord, traumatic brain injury, amputation, severe burn cases — lifetime damages.
- [Slip & Fall Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/slip-and-fall-lawyer-los-angeles): Premises negligence claims — wet floors, poor lighting, defective stairs.
- [Premises Liability Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/premises-liability-lawyer-los-angeles): Negligent security, pool accidents, dog bites, structural failures on unsafe property.
- [Hit & Run Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/hit-and-run-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Uninsured motorist claims when the at-fault driver flees.
- [Wrongful Death Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/wrongful-death-lawyer-los-angeles): Fatal accident claims for surviving family members.
- [Rear-End Collision Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/rear-end-collision-lawyer-los-angeles): Whiplash and disc injury claims from rear-end crashes.
- [T-Bone Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/t-bone-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Intersection side-impact collision claims.
- [Head-On Collision Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/head-on-collision-lawyer-los-angeles): Wrong-way and fatal head-on crash claims.
- [DUI Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/dui-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Drunk driving injury claims, punitive damages.
- [Multi-Vehicle Accident Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/multi-vehicle-accident-lawyer-los-angeles): Freeway pile-up and chain-reaction crash claims.
- [Dog Bite Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/dog-bite-lawyer-los-angeles): California strict liability dog bite and animal attack claims.
- [Spinal Cord Injury Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/spinal-cord-injury-lawyer-los-angeles): Paralysis and spinal cord injury claims — life care planning.
- [Traumatic Brain Injury Lawyer](https://getlawdog.com/traumatic-brain-injury-lawyer-los-angeles): TBI and concussion claims — neuropsychological documentation.
